_readme: LinkedIn does not offer a public API for reading arbitrary profiles' experience/education/certifications — their official API only returns data for the authenticated member and requires a partnership-approved OAuth app. There is no client-side or server-side call a static portfolio site can legally/technically make to 'pull' someone else's LinkedIn data live. To use LinkedIn content here: (1) export it yourself from LinkedIn (Settings > Data Privacy > Get a copy of your data), or (2) use LinkedIn's official OAuth 'Sign In with LinkedIn' + Profile API from a backend you control and cache the result into a file shaped like this one, then point config.json's integrations.linkedin at it. This file shows the expected shape so the render code (js/linkedin.js) has something to consume once populated.

experience.description: Leading backend architecture for a multi-tenant billing platform.
